description: Per-host CPU / memory / disk / network from the physicalhost collector. InfluxDB Flux queries against the `metrics` bucket, filtered by host_id. Use the host dropdown to focus on one host.
title: DevOps Toolkit — Physical Host Metrics

targets.query: from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "physicalhost_cpu") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage_pct") |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.host_id, set: $host_id) or "$host_id" == "All") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "physicalhost_memory") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "used_mib") |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.host_id, set: $host_id) or "$host_id" == "All") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "physicalhost_disk") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "used_gib") |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.host_id, set: $host_id) or "$host_id" == "All") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "physicalhost_probe") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency_ms") |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.host_id, set: $host_id) or "$host_id" == "All") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")

targets.rawSql: SELECT id, ip_address, state, last_check_at FROM physical_hosts WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (last_check_at IS NULL OR last_check_at < now() - interval '5 minutes')
